title: Associativity of the proper/open tower maps on one supplied staircase
statement: Let $A$ be a collection of schemes and $F$ a proper/open calculus on it [def-sp-proper-open-calculus]. Let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$, $h:Z\to W$ be quasi-compact scheme morphisms between members of $A$. Supply a compatible three-map compactification staircase $T$, with all six ambient schemes belonging to $A$. For each of its four binary towers write $\alpha$ for the tower isomorphism defined from the calculus. Then $(\alpha_{f,g}\star H_h)\,\alpha_{fg,h}$ equals the functor associator followed by $(H_f\star\alpha_{g,h})\,\alpha_{f,gh}$, as natural transformations from $(H_f H_g)H_h$ to $H_{fgh}$. The statement assumes the staircase and uses no geometric existence hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0F7K, lemma-pseudo-functor, staircase and final interchange calculation

proof.text: Specialize vertical pasting to the middle and bottom squares and horizontal pasting to the first and middle squares. Transport named proper and open composites by equality induction. Cancel inverse compositors to obtain the two pasting equations without inverse factors.

At an arbitrary object N in the first ambient category, use naturality of the bottom gamma at the component of the first gamma. Substitute both pasting equations and naturality of the proper compositor at the open compositor. This proves the core component identity.

Expand the four tower isomorphisms componentwise. Naturality moves the outer proper compositor to the right, and pAssoc makes the final proper compositor common; cancel it. Naturality moves the initial open compositor to the right, and jAssoc identifies its product with the alternative open composite. Apply the core identity and naturality of the proper compositor. Extensionality proves equality of natural transformations.

theorem properOpen_staircase {A : Scheme.{u} → Prop}
    (F : ProperOpenCalculus.{u, v, w} A)
    (X Y Z W : {X : Scheme.{u} // A X})
      (f : X.1 ⟶ Y.1) (g : Y.1 ⟶ Z.1) (h : Z.1 ⟶ W.1)
      [QuasiCompact f]
      [QuasiCompact g]
      [QuasiCompact h]
      (T : Compactification.Tower f g h) (hT : TowerObjects (A := A) T) :
      Functor.whiskerRight
          (F.towerIso X Y Z T.fg ⟨hT.1, hT.2.1, hT.2.2.2.1⟩).hom
          (F.H Z W T.ch hT.2.2.1) ≫
          (F.towerIso X Z W T.fg_h ⟨hT.2.2.2.1, hT.2.2.1, hT.2.2.2.2.2⟩).hom =
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft (F.H X Y T.cf hT.1)
            (F.towerIso Y Z W T.gh ⟨hT.2.1, hT.2.2.1, hT.2.2.2.2.1⟩).hom ≫
          (F.towerIso X Y W T.f_gh ⟨hT.1, hT.2.2.2.2.1, hT.2.2.2.2.2⟩).hom
